parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of a kitchen pot made of stainless steel, typically circular and slightly convex to fit securely on the pot.
parts.Functional_description: The lid covers the pot to retain heat and moisture during cooking, and it may have a handle for easy removal.
parts.Movement_description: The lid can be lifted or placed on the pot but does not move independently during use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the kitchen pot made of stainless steel, cylindrical in shape with handles on the sides.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds food and liquids for cooking, providing the main volume for heating and boiling.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary during cooking but can be lifted or moved using the side handles.
